title: Celsius temperature is kelvin temperature minus 273.15
summary: The BIPM concise SI summary defines Celsius temperature by t/°C = T/K − 273.15.
body: The BIPM concise summary of the SI says the degree Celsius is equal in magnitude to the kelvin, and that Celsius temperature t is related to thermodynamic temperature T by t/°C = T/K − 273.15. The offset 273.15 is exact in that equation. It is the definition of the scale, not a new measurement of the melting point of ice.

sources.title: The International System of Units (SI), concise summary, 9th edition
